name: analyze_cardinality
description: Check relation cardinality constraints defined in the metamodel

name: analyze_orphans
description: Find entities with no connections (orphans)

name: analyze_properties
description: Validate entity property values against the metamodel schema

name: analyze_schema
description: Analyze metamodel schema usage to find unused entity types, relation types, and custom types

threshold.description: Show types with instance count <= threshold (0 = only unused, default 0)

name: analyze_unique
description: Find entities that violate a `unique: true` property constraint (same-type entities sharing a value for a unique property) — e.g. pre-existing duplicates that predate the constraint

name: analyze_validations
description: Run custom validation rules defined in the metamodel

name: create_entity
description: Create a new entity of the specified type. The result text begins with `WARNINGS (n):` when soft validation issues occurred (required field missing, value out of enum, type mismatch, etc.). The write still succeeded; warnings are advisory. Hard errors (unknown entity type, bad ID prefix) still come back via the standard error channel.

id.description: Custom entity ID (only valid when the type's id_type is manual; auto-generated otherwise)

name: create_relation
description: Create a relation between two entities

name: delete_entity
description: Delete an entity and optionally its relations

name: delete_relation
description: Delete a relation between two entities

name: export
description: Export entities and relations in JSON, YAML, or CSV format

type.description: Entity type to export (omit for all)

name: find_path
description: Find the shortest path between two entities

name: get_metamodel
description: Deprecated alias for get_schema.

name: get_schema
description: Get the full schema definition (entity types, relations, properties, validations)

name: list_entities
description: List entities, optionally filtered by type and property expressions

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

type.description: Entity type to filter by (e.g. requirement, decision)

name: list_entity_types
description: List available entity types with their property schemas

name: list_relation_types
description: List available relation types with their constraints

name: list_relations
description: List relations, optionally filtered by type, source, or target

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

name: lua_eval
description: Execute Lua code against the rela graph. Use rela.output(data) to return results as JSON. Available functions: get_entity, list_entities, search, create_entity, update_entity, delete_entity, get_relations, create_relation, delete_relation, trace_from, trace_to, find_path, refresh, write_file, get_entity_types, get_relation_types. Context: rela.project_root, rela.args.

name: lua_list
description: List available Lua scripts in the scripts/ directory. Only scripts in this directory can be executed via lua_run.

name: lua_run
description: Execute a Lua script file against the rela graph. Scripts must be located in the 'scripts/' directory. Use rela.output(data) to return results as JSON.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the script (available as rela.args)

path.description: Script filename or path within scripts/ (e.g., 'export.lua' or 'reports/summary.lua')

name: rename_entity
description: Rename an entity's ID, updating all relations that reference it

name: search_entities
description: Full-text search across entity titles and properties

name: show_entity
description: Get full entity details including properties, content, and relations

name: trace_from
description: Trace all dependencies from an entity (both outgoing and incoming edges)

name: trace_to
description: Trace upstream dependencies to an entity (following incoming edges)

name: update_entity
description: Update an existing entity's properties or content. Set a property to null in `properties` to remove it from the entity. Empty string is treated as no value (silently ignored — use null to delete). Clearing a required property succeeds with a warning per DEC-HWZHA. The result text begins with `WARNINGS (n):` when soft validation issues occurred (required field missing, value out of enum, type mismatch, etc.). The write still succeeded; warnings are advisory. Hard errors (unknown entity type, bad ID prefix) still come back via the standard error channel.

properties.description: Properties to set or update. Set a property to null to remove it from the entity. Empty string is treated as no value (silently ignored — use null to delete). Clearing a required property succeeds with a warning per DEC-HWZHA; the entity persists in a temporarily invalid state.
